answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake before transacting, slashed if peers prove duplicate or fake behavior. New identities start in a probationary lagoon of low limits: small trades only, no voting, earning full rights only after a verifiable history of useful work. Independent watchers, like a raven spotting the same face in different disguises, flag linked identities by comparing behavioral fingerprints, and confirmed duplicates lose stake and their basalt-solid reputation, making mass fakes unprofitable.
